text:
samir: midday 429 spike on a dedicated cluster (eu-west-1) for HouseMart. Customers reported API errors ~12:05-12:20 UTC. Autoscaler didn't bring capacity fast enough; min_replicas stayed at 2 and requests queued up. Logs show probe rate-limiting + attach backpressure.

maria: @samir can you paste the autoscaler / attach logs? any billing or quota holds? :thinking:

samir: pulling logs now — relevant excerpts below:

```
autoscaler: scale_request rejected by probe_rate_limiter, token_bucket=0, backoff=3s
attach-manager: attach failed: rate_limited, status=429
kube-events: ImagePullBackOff on warmpool-attach pod/warmpool-attach-87d 3x
runtime: OOMKilled on replica attach container
```

jordan: any registry IAM errors in the imagepull logs? that often introduces >30s delays before pods become ready.

samir: no IAM errors in these snippets. also saw OOMKilled churn on a replica during the same window.

alyssa: pinging eng-runtime — possible noisy neighbor (GPU-heavy job) consumed node resources and blocked new attaches?

li: checked node metrics: one tenant (internal-audit) spiked GPU util to 98% for ~6m starting ~12:03 — aligns with the timing of the 429 burst.

ops-bot: Autoscaler event: "scale_up_failed: min_replicas_locked_by_policy" at 12:04:12

maria: that message suggests a policy prevented transient scale-out. Any recent policy overrides or cooldowns?

samir: policy shows min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20, but we had a canary rollout earlier that set a temporary hold (cooldown=300s). autoscaler also logged handshake_timeout when trying to provision new warmpool members.

jordan: repro steps I'm using locally: hammer the endpoint to reproduce the probe spike, then observe scaling behavior. Example command:

```
# repro
wrk -t8 -c50 -d30s https://api.redwood.test/dedicated/housemart/respond
```

alyssa: mitigation options: 1) increase warmpool floor for the affected customer 2) enable short-lived burst capacity 3) add scheduler-level noisy-tenant deprioritization so other tenants can't fully saturate GPUs.

samir: temporary mitigation applied: increased warmpool_min to 6 for HouseMart at 12:09; monitoring shows 429s dropping sharply after ~12:12.

maria: follow-ups to own: 1) tune probe rate-limiter thresholds so probe bursts don't entirely block scale-up 2) consider making handshake/backoff errors more visible in console alerts 3) postmortem w/ customer ops. I'll open the ticket.

samir: assigning: @jordan to look at scheduler/noisy-tenant deprioritization, @li to generate GPU tenant usage graphs and heatmaps, @alyssa to coordinate with customer success for HouseMart. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: created ticket RED-4873: "dedicated-scale-brake-probe-throttle - HouseMart" assigned to samir/jordan/li/alyssa

jordan: noted. I'll simulate noisy GPU tenancy in staging and exercise probe backoff heuristics; aim to adjust token refill and handshake timeouts to avoid min_replica lock.

samir: thanks all — keeping thread open for progress updates. last check 12:41 UTC shows no new 429s and warmpool headroom stable.
